items.headline: Yemen me bus-truck par hamla, 26 mare
items.detail: Somvaar ko Yemen ke Lahj prant me bus aur truck par hawai hamle me 26 log mare gaye — 12 Houthi ladake aur 14 nagrik; hamle ke liye Houthi Saudi ko aur sarkar Houthi ko zimmedaar thahra rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen griha yuddh, Saudi-Houthi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ukraine ne Russia ki refinery par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ke General Staff ne pushti ki 23 November ko drone hamle me Perm ki Lukoil refinery, Rostov ki Novoshakhtinsk refinery aur Tatarstan ke Kaleykino pumping station ko nuksan pahuncha; Perm refinery seema se lagbhag 1,500 km door hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia yuddh, tel par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Finland border par Russia ka sainya adda
items.detail: Finland ke sarkari prasarak Yle ki satellite tasveeron se pata chala Russia Finland se 60 km door Kamenka sainya adde ko dobara bana raha hai; 69th Motor Rifle Division ke liye 11,000 sainikon ki tainaati ki yojana hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Finland, NATO vistar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Libya me Ukraine ne Russia ka yuddh-pot duboya
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Benghazi bandargah par Ukraine ke 7 samudri drone ne Russia ki corvette Merkuriy ko duboya aur Angara jahaz ko nuksan pahunchaya; Zelensky ne isey 'exemplary operation' kaha.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine ki long-range strike kshamata, Libya sangharsh — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Ministry of Defense of Russia, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Finland khadi me Russia ke jahaz par hamla
items.detail: Zelensky ne pushti ki Ukraine ne Shanivaar ko Finland ki khadi me Russia ke cargo jahaz Sparta II par drone hamla kiya; Norway ne savdhani baratne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Baltic Sagar, NATO-Russia tanaav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Huawei doshi: 12 me se 10 aarop sabit
items.detail: Brooklyn ki jury ne Huawei ko Iran pratibandh ullanghan, bank dhokhadhadi aur trade secret chori ke 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi thahraya; racketeering aarop se bari, saza September 2027 me.
items.exam_angle: America-Cheen tech yuddh, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Estonia rail border band karne par vichaar
items.detail: Pradhan Mantri Kristen Michal ne kaha Estonia Narva rail crossing band karne par vichaar kar raha hai; 1 December se sadak seema band ho rahi hai, GRU tod-fod koshish ke baad.
items.exam_angle: NATO-Russia tanaav, Baltic suraksha — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Nenea hartia, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: CIA-ODNI ke khule network me sendh
items.detail: America ki CIA aur ODNI ke khule-source khufiya network me sendh lagi, kuchh avargeekrit jankari ujagar hui; New York Times ne report kiya, gopniya jankari surakshit rahi.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha, OSINT — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Sarkozy-Brunni par naya mukadma chalega
items.detail: France ke poorv Rashtrapati Nicolas Sarkozy aur unki patni Carla Bruni par gawah se bayan badalwane ke aarop me mukadma chalega; pehli sunvai 1 April 2027 ko.
items.exam_angle: France rajneeti, bhrashtachar — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Georges-Francis Seingry, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Zelensky ab Congress se madad mangenge
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha agar Trump saal-ant tak Putin se shanti samjhota na kara paye to Ukraine nayi Democrat-niyantrit Congress se sainya madad aur sakht pratibandh mangega.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, America rajneeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ki Houthi hamle se chetavni
items.detail: America ke Videsh Vibhag ne Madhya Poorv me apne nagrikon ko Houthi hamlo aur Iran ke khatre ko dekhte hue satark rehne ko kaha; udaan radd aur hawai-kshetra band hone ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav, Houthi hamle — West Asia

items.headline: Shenzhou-24 uda, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri
items.detail: Cheen ke Shenzhou-24 ne Jiuquan se udaan bhari; Pakistan ke Zeeshan Ali Tiangong station par jaane wale pehle videshi antariksh-yatri bane, ek hafte ke mission par.
items.exam_angle: Tiangong station, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri — UPSC S&T

items.headline: Mississippi ke paas viman gira, 6 lapata
items.detail: New Orleans se Fort Myers ja raha Cessna viman Horn Island ke paas samudra me gira; 4 vayask aur 2 bachche sawaar the, Coast Guard talaash me juta hai.

items.headline: Senegal ko Africa Cup khitaab wapas mila
items.detail: CAS ne CAF ka faisla palat diya; Senegal ki 1-0 se jeeti final wali jeet bahal hui aur Morocco ko diya gaya khitaab wapas liya gaya.
items.exam_angle: CAS, field-of-play siddhant — khel kanoon

items.headline: UAE bus-takkar me 13 mare, Bharatiya bhi
items.detail: Ras Al Khaimah me 41 yatriyon wali bus khadi truck se takra gayi; 13 log mare, 14 ghayal; Dubai sthit Bharatiya vanijya dutavas ne pushti ki Bharatiya nagrik bhi mare gaye.

items.headline: Shein ko $100 million jurmana
items.detail: America ki FTC ne kaha Shein $100 million dega — der se delivery, nakaratmak review dabane aur kapas ki utpatti par galat daavon ke aarop; Shein ne zimmedaari nahi mani.
items.exam_angle: America upbhokta suraksha, FTC — UPSC economy

items.headline: Bangladesh me garment mazdooron ka pradarshan
items.detail: Gazipur me vetan badhane ki mang par hazaron garment mazdooron ne highway roka; police ne aansu gas aur sound grenade chhode, 70 se zyada factory band hui; mazdoor nyuntam vetan 12,500 se badhakar 30,000 taka chahte hain.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh garment udyog, shramik vetan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Nepal me 5.4 ka bhookamp, Bharat me jhatke
items.detail: USGS ke mutabik Nepal ke Koshi prant me subah 7:02 baje 5.4 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya; Bharat, Bhutan, Bangladesh aur Cheen me jhatke mehsoos hue; ab tak koi hatahat ya nuksan ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Himalaya bhookamp kshetra — UPSC geography

items.headline: Cartagena supermarket me bandhak sankat
items.detail: Colombia ke Cartagena me sashastr hamlaavaron ne Exito supermarket me lagbhag 30 logon ko bandhak banaya; 10 ko riha kar diya gaya, police aur sena ne dukaan ko gher rakha hai.

items.headline: Houthi Aden ke 60 km paas pahunche
items.detail: Houthi ladake Yemen ki asthayi rajdhani Aden se lagbhag 60 km door pahunch gaye; sarkari sena ne raksha rekha banayi aur kaha Aden surakshit rahega.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih-yuddh, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Putin ne badle ki dhamki di
items.detail: Putin ne kaha Ukraine ne Trump ki appeal ke bawjood refineries par hamle jaari rakhe; badla tay hai, aur hamlo se refinery processing 45% ghata hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Uttar Korea ki Swiss karyalaya band karne ki dhamki
items.detail: Kim Yo Jong ne kaha Songdowon shivir par Swiss pratibandh ke baad Pyongyang me Swiss karyalaya band karne par vichaar hoga.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea-Russia sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia hamle me 2 mare, 40 ghayal
items.detail: Russia ke subah ke hamle me ek ghar tabah hua aur paanch manzila building ko nuksan pahuncha; chaar bachche bhi ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Odesa hamle me 2 mare, ladka bhi
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Odesa me ek 17 saal ke ladke samet 2 log mare gaye, 3 ghayal; Kyiv me drone ke malbe se building me aag lagi, 2 ghayal.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bangladesh me garment vetan 36% badha
items.detail: Vetan board ne nyuntam vetan 12,500 se badhakar 17,000 taka kiya; mazdoor 30,000 taka mang rahe the, 1 December se lagu hoga.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh garment udyog, shramik vetan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Colombia me car bomb, 23 ghayal
items.detail: Villavicencio me sarkari karyalaya ke bahar car bomb phata, 23 log ghayal; rashtrapati ne FARC-EMC vidrohi gut ko zimmedaar thahraya.
items.exam_angle: Colombia hinsa, FARC shanti samjhota — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ko pehla gathbandhan saathi mila
items.detail: Israel me Eisenkot ki Yashar party ne Lieberman ki party se pehla gathbandhan samjhota kiya; 6 December tak sarkar banane ki samay-seema hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel rajneeti, Netanyahu — UPSC IR

items.headline: America sainik ne Cheen ko raaz beche
items.detail: America ke sena sargent Jian Zhao ne Cheen se jude kharidaron ko HIMARS aur sainya jankari bechne ka aarop mana; 10 saal tak ki saza ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Cheen jasusi, HIMARS — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Samara ki 2 refinery par drone hamla
items.detail: Raat ke drone hamle me Rosneft ki Syzran aur Kuibyshev refinery me aag lag gayi; governor ne 145 drone giraye jaane aur 1 vyakti ki maut ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Fort Hood hamlaawar ki execution rokne ki arzi
items.detail: 2009 Fort Hood hamle ke doshi Nidal Hasan ne 3 December ko firing squad se hone wali execution par rok ke liye Kansas court me arzi di; sunvai aaj hogi.

items.headline: Riyadh tower par dobara hamla, 11 ghayal
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Houthi drone ne Riyadh ke King Abdullah Financial District ki PIF Tower par dobara hamla kiya; 11 log ghayal hue, jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain.
items.exam_angle: Houthi hamle, Saudi-Yemen sangharsh — UPSC IR

items.headline: America ki sabse badi scam karvai
items.detail: America ke Nyay Vibhag ne duniya bhar me 400 se zyada mamlo me 800 se zyada aaropiyon par karvai ki; FBI ke Operation Blackout me 4 mahadweepon par 29 scam compound dhwast kiye gaye.
items.exam_angle: Cyber dhokhadhadi, Operation Blackout — UPSC S&T

items.headline: Gaza me doosra Hamas adhikari mara gaya
items.detail: Budhvaar subah Gaza City me Israeli hamle me Hamas ke suraksha adhikari Mohammad Abuelouf, unki patni aur 2 bachche mare gaye; 24 ghante me doosre bade Hamas adhikari ki maut hai.
items.exam_angle: Gaza sangharsh, yuddh-viram — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ka drone Poland ki seema me ghusa
items.detail: 23 November ki raat Russia ka nigrani drone Poland ke hawai-kshetra me ghus gaya; Poland ne ise jaanboojh kar uksav kaha, lekin nagrikon ko khatra dekh kar use giraya nahi.
items.exam_angle: NATO-Russia tanaav, Poland — UPSC IR

items.headline: Saudi ne Hodeida bandargah par hamla kiya
items.detail: Saudi-led gathbandhan ne Houthi ke kabze wale Hodeida port par hamla kiya aur Saada-Amran me lakshya dhwast kiye; Houthi ne Saudi bandargahon par badle ki dhamki di.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC IR

items.headline: Shanghai chief Chen Jining jaanch ke ghere me
items.detail: Cheen ki bhrashtachar-rodhi agency ne Politburo sadasya aur Shanghai party chief Chen Jining par 'gambhir anushasan ullanghan' ki jaanch shuru ki; 2025 se chauthe Politburo sadasya par jaanch hai.
items.exam_angle: Cheen rajneeti, Xi ki bhrashtachar-rodhi muheem — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU ka Russia par 22nd sanctions package
items.detail: European Commission ne Russia par 22nd sanctions package prastav kiya — 60 bank SWIFT se bahar, 70 se zyada shadow fleet jahaz, aur EU me Russia ke jhande tale khel par pratibandh.
items.exam_angle: EU-Russia pratibandh, SWIFT, shadow fleet — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hanoi restaurant dhamaka, 6 mare
items.detail: Hanoi ke Dong Da jile me hotpot restaurant me gas dhamake se 6 log mare aur 10 ghayal hue; aas-paas ki lagbhag 10 imaraton ko nuksan pahuncha.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Savasleyka hawai-adda par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Russia ke Savasleyka hawai-adde par hamla kiya, jahan Kinzhal missile le jaane wale MiG-31K viman tainat hain.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kinzhal missile

items.headline: Merz: Europe Russia ko uski seema dikhayega
items.detail: Bundestag me Merz ne kaha Russia Baltic se Black Sea tak badh raha hai, isliye 2027 ka defence budget €139.4 billion rakha gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Germany defence budget, NATO kharch

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas adhikari, parivar ke 4 mare
items.detail: Al-Shati camp me Israeli hamle me Hamas ke uttar Gaza suraksha pramukh Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, unki patni aur do betiyan mare gaye, 12 ghayal.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine sangharsh, Gaza yuddh-viram

items.headline: Saudi ne Ras Tanura par 7 drone giraye
items.detail: Houthi hamle ke jawab me Saudi air defence ne Ras Tanura par 4 aur Eastern Province me 3 drone mare, koi ghayal nahi.
items.exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh, Ras Tanura tel refinery

items.headline: Raat ke hamlo se Ukraine me bijli gayi
items.detail: Russia ke raat bhar ke hamlo ke baad Ukraine ke paanch kshetron me bijli chali gayi aur Zaporizhzhia parmanu sanyantra ki bahari bijli 2026 me 17vi baar band hui; Kyiv aur Kharkiv me log mare aur ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump Iran netaon ko nishana banane ki bahas
items.detail: NBC ki report ke mutabik Trump prashasan nau mahine se chal rahe Iran yuddh ko khatm karne ke liye varishth Iranian netaon ko nishana banane par bahas kar raha hai, lekin Trump ne abhi koi antim faisla nahi liya hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Landmine se 2025 me 6,929 log mare-ghayal
items.detail: Landmine Monitor 2026 ke mutabik 2025 me duniya bhar me 6,929 log landmine aur yuddh ke avasheshon se mare ya ghayal hue — 2020 ke baad sabse zyada; 84% nagrik the aur sabse zyada 1,891 Myanmar me.
items.exam_angle: Landmine Ban Treaty, Myanmar-Syria — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza toofan se 17.6 lakh tent-wasi khatre me
items.detail: Gaza ke sarkari media karyalaya ne chetavni di hai ki aane wale dinon me aane wala toofan tenton me reh rahe 17.6 lakh visthapit Falasteeniyon ki jaan khatre me daal sakta hai; 6 November ke toofan me 70,000 tent doob gaye the.
items.exam_angle: Gaza manaviya sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump 16 deshon par naye tariff ki taiyaari
items.detail: Reuters ke mutabik Trump prashasan Section 301 jaanch ke baad Bharat samet 16 bade vyaparik saajhedaaron par 15% se 25% tak naye shulk lagane ki taiyaari me hai; Supreme Court ne pehle wale shulk February me radd kar diye the.
items.exam_angle: America vyapar neeti, Section 301 — UPSC economy

items.headline: CIA-ODNI par cyber hamla, khufiya data leak
items.detail: CIA, ODNI aur NGA ke open-source intelligence system me ghuspaith hui; kuchh unclassified jaankari leak hui, classified data surakshit raha.
items.exam_angle: US intelligence, cyber suraksha, OSINT
items.image_credit: Carol M. Highsmith, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Huawei 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi
items.detail: America ki jury ne Huawei ko bank fraud aur trade secret chori ki sajish samet 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi paya; racketeering ke aarop se bari kiya gaya.
items.exam_angle: America-China, Iran pratibandh, trade secret

items.headline: Australia: Big Tech par sakht online kanoon
items.detail: Australia ne Digital Duty of Care kanoon pass kiya; harmful content na hatane par company par global revenue ka 5% tak jurmana lag sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Digital governance, Big Tech niyaman

items.headline: Trump ka 14 deshon par tariff prastav
items.detail: USTR ne Bharat samet 14 vyaparik saajhedaaron par 25% tak shulk ka prastav diya; China par 20% pehle ke shulk ke upar lagega, lagu January se pehle nahi hoga.
items.exam_angle: America vyapar neeti, Section 301 — UPSC economy

items.headline: Hormuz me 2 tanker mine se jale
items.detail: Hormuz jaldamroomadhya me mine se do tel tanker phatkar jal gaye; Iran ne nigrani sakht kar di aur kaha jahaz samanvay karke guzrein, varna khatra hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jaldamroomadhya, tel vyapar, Iran-America tanav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Ukraine shanti ki koi deadline nahi
items.detail: Trump ne New York Post ko kaha Ukraine-Russia shanti samjhote ke liye unhone koi samay-seema nahi tay ki; Zelensky ke January tak samjhote wale daave par hanse aur kaha dono pakshon ki marzi se hi shanti hogi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia shanti vaarta, America ki bhoomika — UPSC IR

items.headline: Microsoft ne 'Code Red' ghoshit kiya
items.detail: 12-13 November ko 24 ghante ke outage ke baad Microsoft ne 'Code Red' abhiyan shuru kiya; Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams aur Copilot thap hue the, ab bhavishya me ek ghante me global recovery ka lakshya hai.
items.exam_angle: Digital buniyadi dhancha, Microsoft 365 outage — UPSC vigyan-tech

items.headline: Balleny Islands me 5.9 ka bhookamp
items.detail: Dakshin Mahasagar ke Balleny Islands kshetra me 5.9 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya, kendra 10 km gehrai me tha; door-daraaz samudri ilaka hone se koi nuksan ya sunami chetavni nahi.
items.exam_angle: Bhookamp, Ring of Fire, plate tectonics — UPSC bhugol

items.headline: AI shak se Asia ke share bazaar dhadaam
items.detail: Kospi 6.2% aur Nikkei 2.8% gira; Nvidia ke CEO Jensen Huang ki wapsi ke baad bhi AI kharch par shak bana raha.
items.exam_angle: AI boom par shak — share bazaar aur arthvyavastha

items.headline: El Nino se Amazon me aag ka khatra
items.detail: October me Amazon me aag ke hotspot 82.6% badhkar lagbhag 24,000 hue; El Nino ke mazboot hone se sookha 2027 tak badh sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: El Nino aur Amazon — paryavaran
items.image_credit: GOES imagery: CSU/CIRA & NOAA, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Russia: videshi bandargah me hamla sambhav
items.detail: Kremlin pravakta Peskov ne Libya me Russian yuddh-pot par Ukraine ke hamle ke baad videshi bandargahon me Ukraine ke jahazon par hamle se inkar nahi kiya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh ka vistaar

items.headline: Cartagena supermarket me bandhak sankat
items.detail: Colombia ki suraksha balon ne Cartagena ke Exito supermarket par hamla karke 17 ghante ki bandhak sthiti khatm ki; sabhi 20 bandhak surakshit bacha liye gaye, ek hamlaavar mara gaya.

items.headline: Canary Islands me ek din me 2,100 pravasi
items.detail: Spain ke Canary Islands me 24 ghante me 2,100 se zyada pravasi pahunche — ek din ka record; zyadatar naavein El Hierro dweep par aayi, saal bhar me kul 28,103.
items.exam_angle: Spain-EU pravasi sankat, Canary route — UPSC IR

items.headline: Solomon Islands ne Australia ko suraksha saathi chuna
items.detail: Solomon Islands aur Australia ne Canberra me sandhi par hastakshar kiye — Australia 'primary security partner' bana, desh me koi videshi sainya adda nahi hoga, aur Australia 10 saal me A$740 million dega.
items.exam_angle: Pacific me China-Australia pratispardha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sudan me RSF drone hamle, 19 nagrik mare
items.detail: Sudan ke Blue Nile rajya me RSF ke drone hamlo me 19 nagrik mare aur 20 ghayal hue; Damazin ke teen aawasiya ilakon par hamla hua, Roseires me bandh aur bijli suvidha par bhi hamla hua.
items.exam_angle: Sudan griha yuddh, drone yuddh — UPSC IR
